get.summary: Liveness and which providers are configured (never their keys)

post.summary: Start a resumable upload of one episode archive
post.description: The phone creates the scan id, so retries are idempotent: posting the same id again returns the same upload plan and the parts already received. The archive is split into parts of `part_size` bytes (the last may be shorter).

get.summary: Upload and processing status of one scan

put.summary: Upload one part of the archive

parameters.name: X-Content-SHA256
parameters.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the part body

put.summary: Upload the episode manifest, after every part

post.summary: Verify the archive and every file against the manifest, then start the pipeline
The pipeline posts its results; the API is the only writer of memory

get.summary: The home's room model (floor polygon, walls, furniture boxes) for the phone's 3D map
Every remembered object with its last confident sighting
One room's memory for a robot (Nav2 map, things, furniture); off unless the owner turns it on
get.description: Read-only. Needs ROBOT_EXPORT_ENABLED=true on the Mac and the robot key (RECALL_ROBOT_KEY) or the device key. `room` picks a room; the default is the newest processed scan's.

403.description: Robot export is turned off on the Mac

post.summary: The Home Memory agent (A2A 1.0, JSON-RPC 2.0); off unless HOME_MEMORY_A2A_ENABLED, robot key
post.description: Request and response bodies are defined by the A2A 1.0 specification (https://a2a-protocol.org/v1.0.0/specification/), served by the a2a-sdk. One skill, find_object: send a message with a thing's name; the answer is a message with a sentence and a data part. Every message is screened by Llama Prompt Guard first; while the screen is unavailable the agent refuses (it fails closed).

get.summary: The Home Memory Agent Card (A2A 1.0); 404 while sharing is off

patch.summary: Fix what a scan was unsure about (name, colour, height, note) or confirm it

200.description: The object as it is now remembered

delete.summary: Forget something a scan got wrong

post.summary: Ask where something is; the Guide agent answers from tool output only
Plan a route from the user's relocalised pose to an object
Confirm the object from one arrival frame (SAM 3.1 + geometry; Muse Spark 1.1 may only downgrade)
Speech to text through Muse Voice Transcribe (the only speech model)

deviceKey.description: A shared key from .env (RECALL_DEVICE_KEY), entered once on the phone and given to the pipeline. Pairing, not a login: the API is reachable through a Cloudflare Tunnel, so every route except /health needs it. A robot uses its own read-only key (RECALL_ROBOT_KEY) in the same header, for the robot export only.

room.description: Room name the user gave, e.g. "Living room"

url.description: Where to PUT this part (relative to the API base, or absolute for R2)

received.description: Already stored; skip it when resuming

detail.description: One plain sentence for a person

ScanChange.description: One difference a rescan found against what Recall remembered in that room

name.description: The user's own name for it, when they gave one

from.description: Where it was, in words: "near the desk" (moved, gone)

to.description: Where it is now, in words: "on the shelf" (moved, new)

detail.description: Why it failed, in one sentence

aligned_to.description: The earlier scan of this room whose map the phone recognised, so both share one frame

fresh.description: The room was scanned before but not recognised: memory for it started over

changes.description: What a rescan found different (empty for a room's first scan)

directions_covered.description: Camera headings in 12 sectors of 30 degrees

walls_covered.description: Bearings around the room (of 12) where the LiDAR saw a wall or tall surface

map_status.description: ARKit's world-mapping status at the end

loop_closed.description: The scan ended within a metre of where it started

Manifest.description: The episode's manifest.json, written on the phone and uploaded last

intrinsics.description: Pinhole intrinsics for the SAVED frame size (scaled from ARKit's full camera image)

world_map.description: Relative path of the saved ARWorldMap, if any

files.description: Every file in the episode with its SHA-256

aligned_to.description: A rescan: the earlier scan whose ARWorldMap the phone relocalised in before recording, so this scan's poses share its world. Absent when the room wasn't recognised (a fresh scan).

compass.description: Where magnetic north lies in the ARKit world of this scan (yaw, degrees, 0 = facing -Z, clockwise seen from above), from the circular mean of compass minus camera yaw while the phone was upright

spread_deg.description: Circular spread of the samples; over 25 means unreliable

RoomModel.description: room.json, built from planes and footprints in the home frame (metres)

floor_polygon.description: Closed outline of the floor, [x, y] vertices, counter-clockwise

height_m.description: Floor to ceiling, or the tallest wall seen

north_deg.description: Direction of magnetic north in the home frame, degrees clockwise from +y seen from above (null when the scan had no reliable compass)

front_dir.description: Unit vector (x, y) the front faces, landmarks only

color.description: Basic colour name measured from the photo pixels inside the box (objects only)

size_m.description: Bounding box x, y, z in metres

ScanResult.description: What the pipeline found, in the home frame (floor z = 0, z up, metres)

transform_to_home.description: 4x4 row-major transform from this scan's frame to the home frame (identity for the first scan)

stats.description: Measured timings and counts for this run

ObjectCorrection.description: What the user fixes after a scan. Send only the fields to change; null clears a field back to the measured value. The user's values win over measurements and later scans never overwrite them.

name.description: The user's own name for it, e.g. work bag

height_m.description: Height above the floor in metres

confirmed.description: The user checked it is right; it then counts as certain

color.description: Basic colour name: the user's if they set one, else measured from the photo

size_m.description: Bounding box x, y, z in metres

needs_review.description: The models were unsure (confidence under 0.7) and the user hasn't confirmed it

RobotExport.description: One room's memory for a robot's navigation stack (ROS 2 / Nav2): the occupancy map, where things and furniture are, and the room's outline. Geometry and labels only: never photos, frames, the user's own names or notes, or anyone's live position. Frame "map" is the home frame: metres, z up, floor at z = 0. Each room is its own frame.

scan_id.description: The processed scan the map and places come from (the room's newest)

map.description: Nav2 map server: map.yaml fields, the size, and map.pgm (binary P5, trinary shades) as base64

origin.description: x, y, yaw of the lower-left pixel

orientation.description: Quaternion x, y, z, w (identity: no measured heading)

session_id.description: A guidance session, if the user is already being guided

text.description: One or two short sentences to speak

grounded.description: Every place, distance and time in the text came from a tool

model.description: The Meta model that phrased it

Pose.description: ARKit camera-to-world transform, column-major, metres (ARKit camera convention)

clock.description: Turn as a clock face; 12 is straight ahead

mode.description: landmarks when tracking is limited or there is no safe path

path.description: Waypoints [x, y] in the home frame (metres)

path_arkit.description: The same waypoints in the phone's ARKit world as [x, z], for the on-device RouteFollower

arrive_say.description: What to say on arrival, e.g. where the object is relative to the person

target_arkit.description: The object's position in the phone's ARKit world [x, y, z], for the arrow drawn above it

floor_y_arkit.description: The floor's height in the phone's ARKit world (metres, y up), for the arrows drawn on the floor

bearing_deg.description: Compass bearing from the room's centre to the object (magnetic, clockwise from north), when the scan had a reliable compass; used for landmark directions

image.description: JPEG of the camera at arrival (any size; intrinsics are for this image)

depth.description: LiDAR depth at arrival: unsigned 16-bit little-endian millimetres, row by row, depth_size in `pose` (0 = none)

pose.description: JSON: {"pose": [16 numbers, ARKit camera-to-world, column-major, in the saved room map's world], "intrinsics": {"fx", "fy", "cx", "cy"} for the JPEG, "image_size": [w, h], "depth_size": [w, h]}

Conflict.description: Not in a state that allows this

Unavailable.description: A required model or service is not configured or not reachable

scan_id.name: scan_id
scan_id.description: Created on the phone (UUID), so retries are idempotent
